propositions: All four matrix cells (Ubuntu 3.11/3.12/3.13 and macOS 3.13) currently collect identical pytest-cov coverage independently, duplicating tracing work across three Ubuntu cells without distinct verdict gain.

Coverage instrumentation adds measurable runner occupancy cost (median 34s wall-clock delta per cell) without adding behavioral or contractual compatibility coverage beyond the primary Ubuntu 3.13 cell.

Ubuntu Python 3.13 should be the sole cell collecting branch coverage and enforcing fail-under threshold, while Ubuntu 3.11/3.12 and macOS 3.13 retain all test assertions but execute uninstrumented to reduce duplicate tracing.
Workflow contract tests must verify exactly Ubuntu 3.13 receives coverage flags and all other three cells receive none, while all four cells retain both default and integration pytest tiers.

Django, NumPy, and SciPy projects all selectively collect coverage on one primary or dedicated configuration while broader compatibility jobs run uninstrumented, establishing precedent for this optimization.
